text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the official Vietnamese press on Monday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
-- Falling rice prices are causing problems for farmers, who are withholding an estimated total of 2-3 million tonnes in hope of an increase.
-- Deputy Prime Minister Nguyen Khanh has called for tough penalties including the death sentence for people convicted of supplying drugs to teenagers in an area close to the Chinese border.
-- Noi Bai International Airport is being upgraded.
-- The government has established a nine-member commission headed by Deputy Prime Minister Nguyen Khanh to combat social evils.
-- Five people and tens of houses have been swept away by a flash flood in the central highland province of Kon Tum.
